en.glass.description: Frosted glass for the top bar, sidebar, composer, stats line and trajectory view — one click on/off.
en.glass.glowHint: Adds the two soft radial glows back on top of the gradient ground (the 0.6.3 look). They are pinned to the screen while the glass panes sit elsewhere, so each pane transmits a different slice of them — off by default; turning it on visibly brightens the top-left corner
en.glass.help: A frosted-glass skin layered over the Catppuccin theme: floating cards (Mica) or the stock layout with a glass material (Compatibility). Blur, frost and backdrop brightness are tunable, with Clear / Standard / Frosted presets. Mica blurs large areas (top bar, composer), so it costs GPU while output streams — pick Compatibility or the Clear preset if that matters.
en.glass.modeHint: Mica restyles the UI into floating frosted cards; Compatibility keeps the stock layout and only swaps the material to glass (no large-area blur — the lighter option)
en.glass.previewGroundHint: This strip is the page ground itself: drag the brightness knob or toggle the glows and it changes on the spot.
en.glass.title: Glassmorphism
